title: Genetics and disease
learning_outcomes: Explain dNA variation in the context of genetics and disease.
Compare and distinguish inheritance in the context of genetics and disease.
Apply absolute risk and penetrance in the context of genetics and disease.
Evaluate and justify decisions about testing limitations in the context of genetics and disease.

lessons.title: DNA variation
lessons.outcome: Explain dNA variation in the context of genetics and disease.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving dna variation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional genetic report critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain dna variation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of dna variation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Inheritance
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish inheritance in the context of genetics and disease.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving inheritance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional genetic report critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain inheritance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of inheritance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Absolute risk and penetrance
lessons.outcome: Apply absolute risk and penetrance in the context of genetics and disease.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving absolute risk and penetrance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional genetic report critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain absolute risk and penetrance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of absolute risk and penetrance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Testing limitations
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about testing limitations in the context of genetics and disease.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving testing limitations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional genetic report critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain testing limitations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of testing limitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of dna variation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of inheritance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of absolute risk and penetrance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of testing limitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
